questions.stem: What is a potential risk associated with the use of nanoparticles?

options.text: They are too expensive for any practical applications
They are too large to have any effect on living organisms
They are so small they can enter cells and the bloodstream, with unknown long-term health effects
They always explode when exposed to air

questions.explanation: Because nanoparticles are extremely small (1-100 nm), they can pass through skin, cell membranes, and into the bloodstream. They may accumulate in organs, and the long-term health effects of exposure to nanoparticles are not yet fully understood. More research is needed to ensure their safe use.
